Container.Name: mc-mod-hub
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Minecraft mod/addon search hub. Aggregates Modrinth, CurseForge, PlanetMinecraft, 9Minecraft, and BetterBedrock search results into one list, shows the required Java/Bedrock edition and game version on every result, supports browsing by category, and surfaces community discussion (with heuristic fake-review flags) and YouTube videos with download links pulled from their descriptions. Configure API keys from the built-in admin portal at /admin.html — no file editing required. Optionally mount your server's mods folder at /mods to enable one-click "Install to my server" and a content-hash-based update checker (both off by default, toggled in admin config).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the web UI

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the settings/config database (API keys, source toggles, admin password)

Config.Name: Mods Folder
Config.Description: Optional: your Minecraft server's mods folder. Only needed for the "Install to my server" button and the update checker (both off by default — enable in admin config after mounting this). Leave blank to skip.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional: random string used to sign admin login sessions. Leave blank and the app generates and persists one on first boot — set this only if you want to fix it yourself (e.g. sharing a secret across multiple instances).

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Initial admin portal password. Only used the very first time the container starts (before the database exists) — change it from within the admin portal afterward.
